title: Display the belief sequence
description: You start from a uniform prior and display each returned belief as a heatmap.

steps.description: You create a zero-filled belief vector and assign equal probability to every free state. Wall positions retain zero probability.
You pass the actions, observations, transition models, sensor parameter, and prior to bayes_filter. The recorded result contains 17 beliefs.

steps.question: Which belief gets the first heatmap index?
steps.answer: enumerate starts at zero, so beliefs[0] receives t=0. Each subsequent returned belief receives the next index.

steps.description: You convert each belief vector into a grid before calling show_heatmap. The loop requests one heatmap for every belief in the returned sequence.
